triggerReasons.message: Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: classifyTrustedValidationLineage and the admissibility path return trusted (reuse allowed) when a merge re-introduces content-unchanged story files, and return rejected untrusted-lineage-path when a non-metadata file's content genuinely differs between evidenceHead and currentHead.
acceptanceBindings.note: CHK-001 happy proves both copies route through the shared net-diff classifier; CHK-002 happy proves RED->GREEN, and adversarial:2 proves the single smoke exercises both the reuse and admissibility paths.
